notes.text: The author says that the six-operation formalism carries a definition of homology and an essential identity between homological and cohomological functions. He lists quasi-coherent sheaves on schemes, topological spaces, étale cohomology and, in the added line, coherent sheaves on analytic spaces. These are transcribed claims, not assertions independently verified in this reading.

The parenthesis says the formalism remains to be developed in the crystalline context, for stratified modules in characteristic zero, with possible Hodge structures over the complex numbers, and for motives. The author explicitly writes je suis persuadé and partout, peut-être. The next sentence starts a situation with a separated finite-type scheme over k and torsion coefficients, but the bottom line is physically cut.

No date is present on this sheet. The author number is 7 at the top and the separate archive foliation is 152 at the lower left. H already supplies both in its note, so neither is treated as an H omission.

The surprising looped elevated mark on Lf prompted comparison of its visible shape with the nearby lowered star. The exclamation marks, both double-stroke derived symbols, looped ell, zero, complex-field C, k and Lambda were inspected individually. This was glyph inspection only; no targeted proof check, re-proof, computation or use of a theorem as background occurred.

Four independent guides are reproduced as TikZ drawings and kept locally after or beside their associated additions. The right guide ends in blank space above the names in the analytic note. Its two-part mark is retained within the guide rather than assigned an unsupported word-level or baseline position.

Three compact isolated dark marks were retained with explicit uncertainty at their source positions below stratifiés, un and avec. Their non-baseline positions do not establish linguistic punctuation. Diffuse copy texture was not treated as text. The final inferred comma in C has no recoverable stroke and is not supplied.

Only the authorized packet, brief, conventions, preamble, notation snapshot and three supplied images were used. Eight crops were made with the assigned out/scripts/crop.py at width 2800. The script ledger records rotation 0 and contrast 1.12. There is no sideways marginal writing requiring a rotation. One broad but vertically tight crop preserves the connected coefficient/addition geometry; it supports several separately logged loci without repeated crops. No OCR, browsing, other readers, other pages, delegation or compilation was used.

coverage: The whole image was viewed once for layout, then half a and half b once each in that order. Every physical line was read against both complete witnesses, including their agreed prose, all accents and punctuation, each inline mathematical glyph, the author number, and the bottom foliation. The author text is one continuous handwritten letter page with interlinear additions and no mathematical display, commutative diagram, typescript, stamp, address, date or closing. All deletions, underlining, four additions and four associated guides were inspected and inventoried. Eight subsequent crop views were confined to unresolved loci or the connected clipped line, with source boxes recorded. H differs in several words, capitalisation, quotation shape, condition state and insertion placement; C doubts were each resolved or retained explicitly. Both witnesses omit the guide drawings and the three isolated uncertain marks. The final line has additional physical truncation beyond C's last-abbreviation doubt, which is marked rather than silently completed.
